episodes.synopsis: After a successful operation carried out by an AEGiS attack unit, Nodoka Takahata seeks a job as an Actress, a woman born with the ability to wield mechanical suits.
episodes.title: Farewell, Narikozaka Manufacturing!

episodes.synopsis: Amid moving into a new office, Shitara finds something and proposes a showdown between the Actresses and the maintenance crew!
episodes.title: Actresses VS Maintenance Crew! - Welcome to the Actress Cafe!

episodes.synopsis: Ghost stories and urban legends continue to exist 300 years into the future. There have been ghost stories at the factory for a long time... but what is the truth?
episodes.title: The Narikozaka Nightmare! - Ninpuu Raiya Gaiden!

episodes.synopsis: With a local festival coming to the area, Yotsuyu wants to use this as an opportunity to improve Narikozaka Manufacturing's image.
episodes.title: Festival Revelry! Narikozaka! (Preparations) - Festival Revelry! Narikozaka! (The Event)

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka is an avid hiker and wants to climb Mt. Takao with Yotsuyu. On the hike, she meets a long-tailed butterfly but finds something else the girls have never seen before...
episodes.title: Terrifying Hiking!? - Fight on, Vapor Haze!?

episodes.synopsis: The Shimoochiai family finds tragedy when their oldest daughter Touka is murdered. Help may be on the way when Inspector Fumika Momoshina appears on the scene.
episodes.title: The Touka Shimoochiai Murder Case (Shitara Chapter) - The Touka Shimoochiai Murder Case (Yotsuyu Chapter)

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka becomes suspicious when Yotsuyu starts coming home from work early. What’s going on here?
episodes.title: Yotsuyu-sama's a Former Delinquent! - Life for the Maintenance Crew!

episodes.synopsis: Nodoka goes to work as usual, but everything is a bit unusual. Is it opposite day?
episodes.title: Nodoka in Wonderland - Narikozaka a La Carte

episodes.synopsis: On Rin-chan's latest expedition, the team overcomes countless obstacles and dangers. What truth will Rin-chan uncover?
episodes.title: Rin-chan Expedition Party Mystery! Search for the Legendary Sasshie! - Fluff: The Terrifying Invader

episodes.synopsis: After spending some time in the water, the gang burns through too much money on gourmet indulgences and “bargain” shopping. What’s Yumi to do?
episodes.title: It's a Vacation to the South, Narikozaka! (Vacation) - It's a Vacation to the South, Narikozaka! (Contest)

episodes.synopsis: It’s a quiet, rainy evening. It won’t stay quiet for long as mechanized chaos is right around the corner!
episodes.title: Rain

episodes.synopsis: All roads have led the Actresses here! It’s the gripping finale of Alice Gear Aegis Expansion!
episodes.title: Farewell, Nodoka Takahata!
